prose: Hacker News links a report that Google will turn off Search for schools that reject its AI tools, with an archive link and a Google blog post on education products. The fuller account is in the NYT-sourced story: Google will make AI tools easier to restrict for students in early 2027, but schools that block AI entirely lose student access to Search.
highlights: Schools that block AI entirely would lose student Search access
Linked sources: archive copy and a Google education blog
basis: Error cache: the page did not load. Written from the HN title and its linked URLs only; details taken from the matching NYT-sourced item.
